curtis-team-models.title: Team Models for Scaling a Design System
curtis-team-models.author: Nathan Curtis
curtis-team-models.note: Introduces the solitary, centralised and federated team models.

curtis-fallacy.title: The Fallacy of Federated Design Systems
curtis-fallacy.author: Nathan Curtis
curtis-fallacy.note: Argues that successful systems always have a central team, plus federated participation.

salesforce-cyclical.title: The Salesforce Team Model for Scaling a Design System
salesforce-cyclical.author: Salesforce UX
salesforce-cyclical.note: Describes the 'cyclical' hybrid: a central team plus a federated group of contributors.

figma-value.title: Measuring the value of design systems
figma-value.author: Figma
figma-value.note: Vendor-run internal experiment: participants with a relevant, up-to-date design system completed a design objective 34% faster. Sample details are limited; treat as indicative.

sparkbox-carbon.title: Yes, Design Systems Do Improve Developer Efficiency and Design Consistency
sparkbox-carbon.author: Sparkbox
sparkbox-carbon.note: Eight developers built a form from scratch, then with IBM Carbon: median 4.2 h vs 2 h (≈47% faster). Small sample; the scratch build always came first, so familiarity with the design favours the second build.

zeroheight-2025.title: Design Systems Report 2025
zeroheight-2025.author: zeroheight
zeroheight-2025.note: Survey of 294 respondents (Sep–Nov 2024). 79% report a dedicated design system team; average team size ≈3 (<100 employees), ≈4 (100–499), ≈9 (500+).

webaim-2025.title: The WebAIM Million: The 2025 report on the accessibility of the top 1,000,000 home pages
webaim-2025.author: WebAIM
webaim-2025.note: Low-contrast text detected on 79.1% of home pages; 94.8% had at least one detectable WCAG 2 failure.

dtcg-format.title: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10
dtcg-format.author: Design Tokens Community Group
dtcg-format.note: A Community Group report, not a W3C Standard; widely implemented by token tooling.

dtcg-announce.title: Design Tokens specification reaches first stable version
dtcg-announce.author: Design Tokens Community Group

ottosson-oklab.title: A perceptual color space for image processing
ottosson-oklab.author: Björn Ottosson
ottosson-oklab.note: The original definition of Oklab, from which OKLCH is derived.

em-oklch.title: OKLCH in CSS: why we quit RGB and HSL
em-oklch.author: Andrey Sitnik, Travis Turner

tailwind-v4.title: Tailwind CSS v4.0
tailwind-v4.author: Tailwind Labs
tailwind-v4.note: The default colour palette moved to OKLCH.

radix-scale.title: Understanding the scale
radix-scale.author: WorkOS
radix-scale.note: A 12-step scale where each step has a defined job: backgrounds, component states, borders, solids, text.

m3-color.title: Color system: how the system works
m3-color.author: Google
m3-color.note: Tonal palettes generated in the HCT colour space; colour roles mapped from tones.

hig-a11y.title: Accessibility
hig-a11y.author: Apple
hig-a11y.note: Recommends a minimum control size of 44×44 pt on iOS/iPadOS.

atlassian-spacing.title: Spacing
atlassian-spacing.author: Atlassian
atlassian-spacing.note: 8px base; tokens from space.025 (2px) to space.1000 (80px), named as multiples of the base.

slds-tokens.title: Design tokens
slds-tokens.author: Salesforce
slds-tokens.note: Salesforce's design system team is widely credited with coining the term 'design tokens' (c. 2014).

bringhurst.title: The Elements of Typographic Style
bringhurst.author: Robert Bringhurst
bringhurst.note: Recommends 45–75 characters per line for single-column text, with 66 widely regarded as ideal.

apca.title: APCA: Accessible Perceptual Contrast Algorithm
apca.author: Myndex Research
apca.note: A candidate contrast method explored for future WCAG versions. Not normative under WCAG 2.x.

eu-eaa.title: Directive (EU) 2019/882 — European Accessibility Act
eu-eaa.author: European Parliament and Council
eu-eaa.note: Applies to many products and services placed on the EU market from 28 June 2025.

brooks.title: The Mythical Man-Month: Essays on Software Engineering
brooks.author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
brooks.note: Source of the observation that communication paths grow as n(n−1)/2 with team size.

kurosu.title: Apparent usability vs. inherent usability: experimental analysis on the determinants of the apparent usability
kurosu.author: Masaaki Kurosu, Kaori Kashimura
kurosu.note: Origin of the 'aesthetic-usability effect': visual appeal correlated strongly with perceived ease of use.

fogg.title: How do users evaluate the credibility of Web sites? A study with over 2,500 participants
fogg.author: B. J. Fogg et al.
fogg.note: 'Design look' was the most frequently mentioned factor in participants' credibility comments.

curtis-space.title: Space in Design Systems
curtis-space.author: Nathan Curtis
curtis-space.note: Introduces the inset, stack and inline vocabulary for spacing tokens.

curtis-product.title: A Design System isn't a Project. It's a Product, Serving Products.
curtis-product.author: Nathan Curtis

curtis-contributions.title: Contributions to Design Systems
curtis-contributions.author: Nathan Curtis
curtis-contributions.note: Separates small contributions (fixes, objective improvements) from large ones that need a formal review such as an RFC.

curtis-criteria.title: Design System Contribution Criteria ("I made this. Does it go in the system?")
curtis-criteria.author: Nathan Curtis

curtis-tiers.title: Design System Tiers
curtis-tiers.author: Nathan Curtis
curtis-tiers.note: A high-standard core used by everyone, with lower tiers for product- or platform-specific parts.

curtis-releasing.title: Releasing Design Systems (six-part series: outputs, cadence, versions, breaking change, dependencies, process)
curtis-releasing.author: Nathan Curtis

curtis-visual-breaking.title: Visual Breaking Change in Design Systems
curtis-visual-breaking.author: Nathan Curtis
curtis-visual-breaking.note: Argues that changes to colour, type and space can break products as surely as API changes.

frost-recipes.title: The Art of Design System Recipes
frost-recipes.author: Brad Frost
frost-recipes.note: Product-specific compositions that live outside the core so the core doesn't fill with one-off components.

callahan-maturity.title: The Design System Maturity Model
callahan-maturity.author: Ben Callahan
callahan-maturity.note: Four stages, beginning with 'Building Version One' and 'Growing Adoption'.

mall-dts.title: Design That Scales: Creating a Sustainable Design System Practice
mall-dts.author: Dan Mall
mall-dts.note: Includes a chapter on pilots: building the system through real product work.

kholmatova.title: Design Systems: A practical guide to creating design languages for digital products
kholmatova.author: Alla Kholmatova
kholmatova.note: Describes systems along three dimensions: strict–loose, modular–integrated, centralised–distributed.

govuk-criteria.title: Contribution criteria
govuk-criteria.author: GOV.UK Design System
govuk-criteria.note: Proposals must be useful and unique; before publication, work is checked to be usable, consistent and versatile.

spotify-encore.title: Reimagining Design Systems at Spotify
spotify-encore.author: Spotify Design
spotify-encore.note: Describes Encore, a 'system of systems' that brought 22 disconnected design systems under one framework.

aria-apg.title: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG)
aria-apg.author: W3C WAI
aria-apg.note: Keyboard and screen-reader patterns for common widgets such as menus, tabs, dialogs and comboboxes.

storybook.title: Storybook: frontend workshop for UI development
storybook.author: Storybook

curtis-interview.title: "We're focused too much on design tokens": Nathan Curtis on design systems today
curtis-interview.author: Design Systems Collective

style-dictionary.title: Style Dictionary
style-dictionary.author: Style Dictionary contributors (originally Amazon)
style-dictionary.note: An open-source build system that turns design tokens into code for any platform.

figma-props.title: Explore component properties
figma-props.author: Figma
figma-props.note: Variant, boolean, text and instance-swap properties.

react-controlled.title: Sharing state between components (controlled and uncontrolled components)
react-controlled.author: React team

govuk-patterns.title: Patterns
govuk-patterns.author: GOV.UK Design System
govuk-patterns.note: Documented solutions to common user problems, such as asking for addresses or dates, and validation.

mdn-intl.title: Intl (internationalisation API)
mdn-intl.author: MDN contributors
mdn-intl.note: Built-in formatting for dates, numbers, currencies and plural rules by locale.
